# xHeal

> xHeal is an AI-powered personal health intelligence platform that connects wearable data, lab results, and symptom patterns to help people understand their health before symptoms appear. Built for people managing chronic conditions, optimizing fitness and recovery, or navigating complex health data.

xHeal was founded by Trifon Getsov after a 4-year personal health crisis. Its predictive AI has been validated against 5,000+ patient records and detects physiological changes — including early insulin resistance and pre-flare signals — before standard clinical markers become abnormal.

## Core Product Pages

- [Home](https://xheal.com/en): Overview of xHeal's health intelligence platform
- [About](https://xheal.com/en/about): Founding story, team, and medical advisors
- [Chat With Your Health](https://xheal.com/en/chat-with-your-health): AI health assistant
- [Health Timeline](https://xheal.com/en/health-timeline): Unified view of health history across sources
- [Flare-Up Trigger Patterns](https://xheal.com/en/flare-up-trigger-patterns): Personalized trigger identification for chronic conditions
- [Health Awareness](https://xheal.com/en/health-awareness): Early detection and awareness tools
- [Specialist-Ready Reports](https://xheal.com/en/specialist-ready-reports): Appointment preparation and data summaries
- [Log Life Events](https://xheal.com/en/log-life-events): Contextual health event logging

## Blog — Chronic Condition Management

- [Chronic Condition Management: The Complete Data-Driven Guide](https://xheal.com/en/blog/chronic-condition-management-guide): Pillar guide covering flare prediction, trigger identification, wearable signals, and care team communication
- [Signs a Flare-Up Is Coming: What Your Body Shows 48 Hours Before](https://xheal.com/en/blog/what-happens-48-hours-before-a-flare-up): 5 measurable physiological changes detectable 24–48 hours before symptom onset
- [5 Hidden Flare-Up Triggers You're Probably Not Tracking](https://xheal.com/en/blog/five-flare-up-triggers-hiding-in-plain-sight): Sleep efficiency, barometric pressure, cumulative stress, medication timing, supplement interactions

## Blog — Health Data & Wearables

- [Understanding Your Health Data: A Complete Guide](https://xheal.com/en/blog/understanding-your-health-data): Pillar guide connecting HRV, lab results, wearable blind spots, and sleep-stress-nutrition patterns
- [What Does HRV Mean? Heart Rate Variability Explained](https://xheal.com/en/blog/understanding-hrv-the-number-that-predicts-tomorrow): HRV basics, age-based reference ranges, 8 causes of HRV drops, how to improve baseline
- [Your Apple Watch Tracks 47 Metrics. Here's What It Still Can't Tell You.](https://xheal.com/en/blog/your-apple-watch-tracks-47-metrics): 5 wearable blind spots: blood chemistry, medications, nutrition, medical history, subjective experience
- [The Sleep-Stress-Nutrition Triangle](https://xheal.com/en/blog/how-sleep-stress-nutrition-connect): Bidirectional cortisol-sleep-nutrition feedback loop and 5 entry points to break the cycle

## Blog — Lab Results & Medical Records

- [6 Lab Tests Your Annual Checkup Misses](https://xheal.com/en/blog/the-lab-tests-your-annual-checkup-misses): HOMA-IR, hs-CRP, ferritin, vitamin D, thyroid antibodies, HbA1c — why they matter and how to request them
- [How to Organize Medical Records from Multiple Hospitals](https://xheal.com/en/blog/from-four-hospitals-to-one-timeline): Step-by-step guide for consolidating records from MyChart, Epic, CommonWell, and PDF sources
- [How to Know Which Lab Tests to Order](https://xheal.com/en/blog/how-to-know-which-lab-tests-to-order): Case study on how xHeal identified non-standard tests that revealed a missed health story

## Blog — Doctor & Specialist Visits

- [How to Prepare for a Doctor Appointment: The Complete Cheat Sheet](https://xheal.com/en/blog/the-doctor-visit-cheat-sheet): One-page health summary template, top questions to ask, doorknob moment avoidance
- [What Your Specialist Wishes You Brought](https://xheal.com/en/blog/what-your-specialist-wishes-you-brought): Data, records, and communication strategies for specialist appointments

## Blog — Fitness & Recovery

- [How to Know If You're Overtraining: What My Data Showed](https://xheal.com/en/blog/overtraining-how-my-data-proved-it): HRV, resting heart rate, and sleep architecture as overtraining signals — with before/after data

## Blog — Product Stories

- [Early Insulin Resistance: I Had It With Zero Symptoms](https://xheal.com/en/blog/case-study-how-xheal-helped-me-reduce-early-insulin-resistance): Founder case study — HOMA-IR detected at 3.83, reversed to 2.0 in 12 weeks
